units: Ḥull. 80ᵃ שור הבר the ox of the prairie, buffalo.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:1:2">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חזיר של ב׳</he> wild swine.

senses.gloss: clear, visible, whence the outside, surface, opp. תוך.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 72b:21">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> a scholar <he>שאין תוכו כבָרוֹ</he> whose inside is not as his outside (who is insincere); <cite ref="Berakhot 28a:19">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:1:7">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>תוך בר</he> the inner parts of the Passover lamb must hang outside (not be put inside, v. R. Akiba in Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:1">ib. VII, 1</cite>); Mekh. Bo, 6 <he>תוך ובר</he> (read <he>תוכו בר</he>); <cite ref="Pesachim 74a:4">Pes. 74ᵃ</cite> R. Ish. called it <he>תוך בר</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="V00520"><he>תך</he></cite> 2 (ed. <he>תוך תוך</he>, Var. in Rashi a. Ar. <cite ref="V00199"><he>תוכברא</he></cite> q. v.).
